Redmond Asset Management Llc bought 3,855 shares as the company’s stock rose 3.67% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 27,304 shares of the health care company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $2.65 million, up from 23,449 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Redmond Asset Management Llc who had been investing in Hca Healthcare Inc Com for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $36.55B market cap company.
